name: RBI Officers in Grade B (Direct Recruitment): General, DEPR and DSIM
summary: Officer entry into the Reserve Bank of India in three streams: General, Economic and Policy Research (DEPR) and Statistics and Information Management (DSIM). Two written phases and an interview. One of the best-paid entry-level government jobs.

status.note: Usually held every year. 2026 cycle: applications 29 April to 20 May 2026; Phase I on 13 June (General) and 14 June (DEPR, DSIM); Phase II on 25 and 26 July 2026; interviews after that.

posts.name: Grade B (DR) General
posts.responsibilities: Regulation, supervision, currency management, banking operations.

posts.name: Grade B (DR) DEPR
posts.responsibilities: Economic research and monetary policy analysis.
posts.notes: 2026: 10 posts. Master's in economics or finance required.

posts.name: Grade B (DR) DSIM
posts.notes: 2026: 10 posts. Master's in statistics, mathematics or related required.

relaxations.note: After deducting military service from actual age, as per notice.

age.summary: 21 to 30 years on the first day of the advertisement month (2026: as on 1 May 2026). Higher limits for M.Phil and Ph.D. holders as per the advertisement.
age.referenceDate: 1st of the month in the advertisement

education.summary: General: a bachelor's degree with at least 60% (50% for SC, ST, PwBD) or a master's with at least 55% (pass for SC, ST, PwBD). DEPR: master's in economics, econometrics, finance and similar. DSIM: master's in statistics, mathematics, econometrics or related fields, as listed in the advertisement.
education.minMarks: 60% in graduation or 55% in PG (General stream)

eligibility.examVsPost: DEPR and DSIM need specific master's degrees; General needs the minimum percentage.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: General stream needs 60% in graduation or 55% in PG. DEPR/DSIM need relevant master's.

papers.name: General Awareness, English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning
Paper I: Economic and Social Issues (objective + descriptive)
Paper III: Finance and Management (objective + descriptive)

selection.meritCalculation: Final merit on Phase II plus interview; Phase I only shortlists. DEPR and DSIM have their own stream-specific papers.
selection.languages: English and Hindi (descriptive papers can be in English or Hindi as per advertisement).

sections.subject: Economic and Social Issues
topics: Growth and development, Indian economy, globalisation
Social structure, social justice, positive discrimination

sections.subject: Finance and Management
topics: Financial system, financial markets, banking regulation, risk management
Basics of derivatives, corporate governance, fintech

salary.officialGrossNote: Reports of the advertisement put gross pay at about Rs 1.5 lakh a month.
salary.notes: RBI has its own pay structure, not the central pay matrix; DA follows RBI rules.

progression.post: Grade E and F (General Manager, Chief GM)

benefits.detail: Furnished accommodation or allowance, medical, leave fare concession, concessional loans, as per RBI rules.

workLife.postings: RBI offices in state capitals and major cities.

difficulty.rationale: Very few posts (60 in 2026) and descriptive economics and finance papers.

ratings.rationale: Usually annual, but vacancies vary a lot.

sources.title: RBI Grade B Notification 2026: 60 vacancies, dates

gaps: Official RBI advertisement not fetched; vacancies, dates and starting basic from a secondary report.
Phase marks are from recent RBI advertisements.
Attempt limit details not confirmed for 2026.
